There is no 'newly low on stock' section. The low-stock level has never been set on any product, so nothing can ever be flagged as low. Only the crossing into out-of-stock is reported.
items.guidance: inventory.warning_stock is NULL on 100% of rows. There is no threshold to cross, so an empty low-stock section is missing configuration, not a quiet morning.

reading.claim: Down on the week, and every peso of it is fewer transactions
reading.next: Magnolia first. It is the one shop where the week and the last day agree, and the last day came in at less than half its own same-weekday level — I would ask the shop what happened on Sunday before reading anything else into it. Greenhills second, as a range question rather than a demand question. Kiamoy White fell to almost nothing there while Curl Sour, King Seedless and the dilis rose — that looks like lines being substituted on the shelf. I would have someone photograph the kiamoy bay rather than trust the counts, because with thousands of lines below zero I cannot tell an empty shelf from a broken record. Third, and this is the one that keeps costing us reads: a clean stock count. Until the negative counts are fixed and low-stock levels are set, every supply explanation I offer is unchecked rather than ruled out. The bayberry champoy is still gone — it traded in the comparison week and not at all in this one. The purchase records are frozen, so I cannot tell you whether it is on order; that needs a fresh StoreHub export.

children.lede: The estate took {estate} last week, {estate.change} on the week before, and the whole of it is fewer transactions — {estate-txn.change} of them — with the basket flat at {estate-atv}.

children.label: the lines that traded and then did not

children.say: Two lines that traded the week before sold nothing at all last week — the honey bayberry champoy and the Taiwan peanut nougat. They are reported on their old figure alone.
They are left out of the ranking rather than counted as nothing, which is why the movers add to less than the estate's fall.

children.note: Stock counts run days behind the sales, so a line that looks empty may only be unrecorded.
children.label: on the stock record

children.note: The shipping plan is built out of those same counts, so its largest requests are its worst records.

children.head: The fall is transactions, and the shape of the week is unchanged

children.say: **Every peso of the gap is traffic through the tills.** Transactions came down almost exactly in proportion to sales, and the average basket finished where it started. Nothing suggests people spending less when they come in; there were simply fewer of them being served.

The rhythm of the week is intact — Saturday and Sunday still carry it, and by a wide margin. If something were breaking in the offer rather than in footfall, I would expect the weekend to sag with the weekdays.

children.head: Three shops fall, three hold, and Rockwell is the one real gainer

children.say: **Greenhills is the largest faller in pesos and Magnolia the sharpest in proportion of the mid-sized shops.** Shangri-La is down too. Against that, Fairview and North Edsa finished level and Rockwell added — which is why I read this as three local problems rather than something estate-wide.
Rockwell's gain settles a question I have been carrying: its lower level was the renovation kiosk, and the recovery is holding. Fairview has stopped sliding too.

children.head: Greenhills: fewer transactions, and I have changed my mind about why

children.say: **I had this one as a shrinking-basket shop. It is not.** Transactions fell nearly as hard as sales and the basket barely moved — I have revised that view.

The weekdays are where the money went. Monday through Wednesday ran well under the same days a week earlier, and the comparison week's own Saturday and Sunday were unusually strong, which flatters the gap.

**On the shelf, the kiamoy money moved rather than left.** Kiamoy White all but stopped while Curl Sour, King Seedless and both dilis lines rose in the same week — that is substitution inside the range, not customers walking away from it.

children.head: Across the range, Aji Mix is the single biggest loser

children.say: **Aji Mix is far and away the largest faller in pesos**, and it is the largest line in the estate, so a few points off it outweighs everything else. Kiamoy White and Strips follow it down; the gains sit in the other kiamoy cuts and the squid lines.

children.head: The one I would act on today

children.say: **Magnolia is the only shop where the week and the last day tell the same story.** Sunday came in at less than half its own same-weekday level — the largest single reading anywhere in the morning's attention list.
